name: classes
description: Classes to add to the `ul` container for the task list.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the `ul` container for the task list.

name: idPrefix
description: Optional prefix. This is used to prefix the `id` attribute for the task list item tag and hint, separated by `"-"`. Defaults to `"task-list"`.

name: items
description: The items for each task within the task list component.

params.name: heading
params.description: The main heading for the task within the task list component.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

params.name: hint
params.description: Can be used to add a hint to each task within the task list component.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to use within the hint. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML to use within the hint. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: status
params.description: The status for each task within the task list component.

params.name: tag
params.description: Can be used to add a tag to the status of the task within the task list component.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to use for the status, as an alternative to using a tag. If `html` or `tag` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML to use for the status, as an alternative to using a tag. If `html` or `tag` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the status container.

params.name: href
params.description: The value of the link's `href` attribute for the task list item.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the item `div`.
